summary: Phases 1 (PrimeTheory.lean, commit be8f2eb0) and 2a (CanonicalModel.lean definitions, commit 4fd37213) remain green and untouched. Phase 2b (canonical_box_witness) was previously BLOCKED on an apparent 'diamond-top precondition' (see prior handoff / commit d5a3101b). This second dispatch identified the ROOT CAUSE: that framing assumed the witness pair is (w, v) with w unchanged, which is false. Cross-checked against a working reference formalization (github.com/ianshil/CK, Coq mechanization of CK/IK completeness with a definitionally-identical canonical relation) confirms the correct construction needs an existentially-quantified EXTENDED world w' >= w (seeded with the diamond-image of the box-witness world u), not w itself -- this fully resolves the diamond-top red herring. However, building w' requires excluding an entire SET of formulas {psi | box psi not in u} simultaneously (a 'Lindenbaum pair' construction), which is infrastructure that does not currently exist anywhere in Cslib (modal_prime_exclusion and Metalogic.prime_exclusion both only exclude a single formula). Adding this generalization is a substantial (150+ line), foundational, shared-infrastructure change to Foundations/Logic/Metalogic/PrimeExclusion.lean, out of scope for this single-file-territory, single-phase dispatch. No sorry/admit/axiom introduced; CanonicalModel.lean is unchanged from its Phase 2a committed state (verified via git diff --stat and a clean lake build).

blockers.description: canonical_box_witness's TRUE conclusion is `exists w' v : CanonicalPrimeWorld Axioms, w <= w' /\ canonicalR w' v /\ phi not in v.val` (an extended w', NOT `exists v, canonicalR w v /\ phi not in v.val` as the v1/v2 plan/report sketch assumed). Building w' requires a 'Lindenbaum pair' prime-exclusion lemma (exclude a whole set Sigma = {box B | B not in u.val} simultaneously, not a single formula) which does not exist in PrimeTheory.lean or Foundations/Logic/Metalogic/PrimeExclusion.lean. modal_prime_exclusion / Metalogic.prime_exclusion only support single-formula exclusion.
blockers.full_note: See the 'UPDATE (second Phase 2b dispatch)' block appended after the original BLOCKER note for Phase 2b in specs/480_intuitionistic_modal_framework/plans/02_intuitionistic-modal-framework-hard.md for the complete technical writeup: the step-by-step construction (seed w' with diamond-images of u, exclude Sigma via the missing pair-exclusion lemma), the reference formalization cross-check (ianshil/CK, theories/Completeness_th/general_th_completeness.v, cmreach + truth_lemma Box case), why this resolves the prior 'diamond-top precondition' framing, and the concrete recommended next steps.

continuation_context: The literature/mathematical question from the PRIOR handoff is now RESOLVED (no further /research needed on 'does IK/CK force diamond-top'). What remains is an infrastructure gap: add a Lindenbaum-pair / set-exclusion generalization of Metalogic.prime_exclusion (e.g. `Metalogic.prime_pair_exclusion`) to Cslib/Foundations/Logic/Metalogic/PrimeExclusion.lean -- given Admissible D Cons S, S consistent with excluding a SET Sigma (no finite subset of S derives any finite disjunction of Sigma), produce a prime T extending S with T disjoint from Sigma. Mirror the existing Zorn's-lemma argument in prime_exclusion (swap 'phi not in T' for 'Sigma inter T = empty' throughout, generalize the cut/EFQ-bridge hypotheses from single-formula to finite-disjunction form); cross-reference github.com/ianshil/CK's `Lindenbaum_pair`/`pair_extCKH_prv` for the exact formulation shape that composes cleanly with Zorn's lemma. This is foundational shared infrastructure (used by every Metalogic file), so it likely warrants its OWN task/phase with its own review, separate from task 480's Intuitionistic/ subtree. Once available, re-dispatch Phase 2b using the seeded-w' construction documented in the plan's Phase 2b UPDATE block; canonical_diamond_witness (2c) will need the mirror-image construction (seed the box-side instead of the diamond-side) using the same new lemma.
